meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启用一套预设的工作模式指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你希望助手能在需要时切换到一个高要求的工作状态。
copy.tagline_en: Apply a preset work-mode directive to your assistant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to follow a binding directive when you request a special mode.

howto.what: 开启后,Claude 会先宣告“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,再把代码任务当项目交付:写下目标和验收标准,列出步骤;改代码前先做一个注定失败的检查,改到通过后,用真实运行(命令行/网页)留证据,并全程记录笔记。
howto.when: 当你在对话中要求进入“ultrawork 模式”(例如说“开启 ultrawork”)且该指令尚未加载时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,修一下登录页报错。
say.note: 它会先定验收标准,再修复并给证据。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork,实现搜索功能并验证。
say.note: 先写会失败的检查,再实现并跑真实场景证明。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式审查这个 PR 的改动。
say.note: 会按较重流程处理:多场景回归验证。

howto.what_en: Claude first announces 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then runs the task like a project: sets goals and acceptance criteria, lists steps, writes a failing check, makes it pass, proves it on a real surface (CLI/web), and keeps a notepad.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request ultrawork mode in the conversation (e.g., 'enable ultrawork') and the directive isn't loaded yet.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix the login page error.
say_en.note: It will set acceptance criteria first, then fix and show evidence.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork, implement search, and verify it.
say_en.note: It writes a failing check first, then proves it on a real scenario.

say_en.text: Review this pull request in ultrawork mode.
say_en.note: Heavy-style handling: edge cases and regression checks.
